QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_10

question.text: Under Regulation 20 of the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, the compliance officer of a Cat III AIF must independently report any deviation to SEBI within:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Regulation 20, as amended via the Second Amendment 2021, requires the compliance officer to independently report any deviation to SEBI forthwith within 7 working days. This is a HARD deadline; it sits independently of the T+10 quarterly activity report cycle. **The Trap:** 24 hours is a market-abuse timeline. 3 working days echoes other SEBI intermediary windows. 30 days is the CTR timeline (Investment Manager → Sponsor/Trustee). **Cross-Exam Context:** III-A/C (Compliance) exams test similar 'forthwith' windows for intermediary deviations. XIX-D covers the same rule for Cat I/II. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Put a pre-committed written trigger matrix on the compliance officer's desk — any breach above a threshold auto-triggers a 7-working-day SEBI filing preparation. Do NOT let the 7-day clock run while legal opines; the officer must report INDEPENDENTLY.
